name: Parliamentary Resolution on a National Security Policy for Iceland (Þjóðaröryggisstefna fyrir Ísland) (2016)
description: Official 2016 edition of Parliamentary Resolution on a National Security Policy for Iceland (Þjóðaröryggisstefna fyrir Ísland) (Parliamentary Resolution on a National Security Policy for Iceland (Þjóðaröryggisstefna fyrir Ísland) (2016)), published by Government of Iceland (Stjórnarráð Íslands) (stjornarradid.is).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Government of Iceland (Stjórnarráð Íslands) (stjornarradid.is) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Government of Iceland (Stjórnarráð Íslands) (stjornarradid.is).
